overrides.reason: least-squares fits whose regressors come from transcendental functions (sin/cos, exp): last-bit differences between glibc and UCRT are amplified by the condition number of the design matrix
iterative optimisation (registration, iterative blurring): when the cost function differs in the last bits the optimiser stops at a slightly different point
